obligations.obligation: Resolve AgentOptions over environment over host file over defaults exactly once at construction.
obligations.mutation: Let file settings override environment or reread ambient configuration on turn two.

obligations.obligation: Ambient configuration contains only provider, model, storage, workspace, per-provider extra_request_params, and context_intelligence.
obligations.mutation: Expose a routing or orchestrator host setting.

obligations.obligation: Parse boolean settings strictly, including the specified false spellings, and reject nonboolean garbage.
obligations.mutation: Interpret the string false as true or silently coerce arbitrary text.

obligations.obligation: Reject unknown host keys by name with the nearest valid key; ignore unrelated seam environment variables.
obligations.mutation: Ignore a misspelled provider key or reject an unrelated engine transport variable as host config.

obligations.obligation: Defaults do not change silently within a contract major.
obligations.mutation: Change the default persistence or storage policy under an unchanged contract major.

obligations.obligation: Provider selection is singular, including github-copilot as one aggregator; model specifies the ceiling.
obligations.mutation: Accept multiple providers because the first is an aggregator.

obligations.obligation: Selection obeys agent-interface ceiling rules without public routing configuration.
obligations.mutation: Allow an ambient setting to increase the per-turn ceiling.

obligations.obligation: Provider requests carry complete input, disable retention, and keep reasoning continuity in bounded local replay.
obligations.mutation: Send previous_response_id by default or discard reasoning continuity when the provider restarts.

obligations.obligation: Only explicit settings supply per-provider request overrides, including deliberate retention opt-in.
obligations.mutation: Enable retention without a host setting or apply one provider's override to another.

obligations.obligation: Provider request overrides cannot change transcript-based session semantics.
obligations.mutation: Require a retained provider conversation id for resume after an explicit retention opt-in.

obligations.obligation: Hosts address storage through root, valid workspace slug, and session ids rather than internal layout.
obligations.mutation: Accept a workspace traversal string, uppercase slug, or a slug longer than 64 characters.

obligations.obligation: Durable sessions remain under the selected root; migrations stay private.
obligations.mutation: Write durable history to a default root despite an explicit storage override.

obligations.obligation: host-config/1 versions independently and admits only additive optional keys without changing existing names, types, or defaults.
obligations.mutation: Make a host key mandatory or rename storage in a minor amendment.

obligations.obligation: Host settings expose no bundle/module/hook/orchestrator, routing, mode, or recipe controls.
obligations.mutation: Add a hooks setting or a mode selector to host configuration.

obligations.obligation: Faces do not offer per-request host configuration.
obligations.mutation: Add a provider or storage field to the accepted HTTP request schema.

obligations.obligation: Host-config conformance discriminates every precedence direction, booleans, unknown keys, and multiple providers.
obligations.mutation: Use only a defaults-only happy path and claim precedence coverage.

obligations.obligation: Verify verbatim provider overrides, excluded public override paths, recorded provider-state posture, and capture forwarding to a destination fixture with context_intelligence absent from environment and faces.
obligations.mutation: Filter an unknown extra_request_params key, keep provider conversation state without opt-in, or accept AMPLIFIER_AGENT_CONTEXT_INTELLIGENCE.

obligations.obligation: Keep provider request overrides off supported command interfaces and face request surfaces.
obligations.mutation: Add extra_request_params to HTTP requests or a supported command flag.

obligations.obligation: Durable sessions use the Amplifier session layout under the selected root; hosts may read it and only the engine writes it.
obligations.mutation: Write transcript.jsonl anywhere but workspaces/<workspace>/sessions/<id>/ or list a directory holding only a capture as a session.

obligations.obligation: context_intelligence is settings-only: no environment form, absent from every command and face surface, and not an AgentOptions field.
obligations.mutation: Accept AMPLIFIER_AGENT_CONTEXT_INTELLIGENCE, add a context_intelligence request field, or add it to AgentOptions.

obligations.obligation: A named destination receives the capture, a refused destination never fails a turn, an absent setting keeps the capture local, and no other Amplifier installation's settings or environment supply a destination.
obligations.mutation: Fail the turn when the destination refuses, or forward to a destination read from ~/.amplifier/settings.yaml or AMPLIFIER_CONTEXT_INTELLIGENCE_SERVER_URL.
